title: Gon Gave Up His Future to End Pitou

cuts.voiceover_text: Pitou finally tells Gon the truth. Kite is already dead. He cannot be brought back. The camera cuts from Pitou to Kite's motionless body, then locks on Gon. He does not explode. He just stares. When he finally faces Kite himself, the hope he carried into that room is gone.

Later, Gon stops begging. Grief turns into something colder. Red energy closes around him while Pitou watches in terror. Gon gives up every bit of strength he could ever have, all for the power to punish Pitou now. Then he rises to face her.

The vow remakes him. When Killua arrives, he finds Gon grown into an impossible adult form, his black hair towering over the battlefield. Gon raises a fist already soaked in blood. Pitou never stood a chance against the life Gon threw away.

Even after everything, Gon gives Pitou no mercy. He hauls her limp body through the trees and drives it into the earth with one final blow. He does not celebrate. The fight ends in blood, silence, and the price Gon has chosen to pay.
